description: Use this when someone asks how much of a pool chemical to add to go from a current to a target level: chlorine (liquid chlorine 12.5 %, bleach 10 % or 6 %, cal-hypo 65 % or 73 %, dichlor, trichlor) for free chlorine; salt for a salt chlorinator; baking soda to raise or muriatic acid to lower total alkalinity; stabilizer (cyanuric acid); calcium chloride for calcium hardness; muriatic acid to lower pH or soda ash to raise it. Levels in ppm (pH for the pH chemicals). Returns the amount in fl oz, oz or lb, a readable amount, the number of common packages, the factor used and a safety line. Not for shock targets or water-balance (LSI) questions.

chemical.description: Product. muriatic_acid_ph lowers pH, muriatic_acid_ta lowers total alkalinity.

current.description: Current level: ppm (free chlorine, salt, alkalinity, stabilizer, calcium hardness) or pH for muriatic_acid_ph and soda_ash.

gallons.description: Pool volume in US gallons (from pool_volume if the user gave dimensions).

target.description: Target level in the same unit as current.

total_alkalinity.description: Only for muriatic_acid_ph and soda_ash: current TA in ppm (default 100); the pH dose scales with it.

name: chemical_dose

link.description: Page of calculatepool.com for the same calculation.

title: Pool chemical dose
